cases.title: Fixing the seller journey after the sale
cases.result: Payout cycle: 2–3 weeks → a fixed 1-week window. Support lead time: 1–2 weeks → 4–5 days.

sections.label: Problem
sections.text: Marketplace sellers waited weeks for cashouts and support answers, which hurt trust in a channel that drives about half of online GMV.

sections.label: What I did
sections.text: Led the seller-experience squad across onboarding, listing and performance. We launched a seller support center and rebuilt order-to-payout into a regular weekly cycle.

sections.label: Next
sections.text: Multi-user access for the seller portal: one email + OTP login for everyone. Category managers see a select-seller view, and seller staff get access by permission.

images.alt: Seller portal Statements and Payouts page with weekly statement periods and payout status
images.caption: Statements & Payouts: weekly settlement periods, an estimated running balance, and payout status per statement.

images.alt: Seller portal Support center listing seller cases with category and status
images.caption: Support center: sellers open cases by category and track them to resolution, in Arabic or English.

cases.title: Order response time from 45 seconds to 2
cases.result: Order response time cut from 45s to 2s, plus 40% faster page loads after a platform upgrade.

sections.label: Problem
sections.text: Placing an order took up to 45 seconds and sometimes crashed, so customers dropped off at the most valuable step.

sections.label: What I did
sections.text: Led a platform upgrade with my squad and fixed order-placement crashes, including combined orders mixing B.TECH and third-party products.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: 2-second responses, lower bounce rates, and +3% conversion for returning MiniCash customers.

cases.todo: Add: how you found the root cause and what you prioritised first

cases.title: Bank installments for high-ticket purchases
cases.result: 60% above sales target in the first month; high-ticket sales up 2%.

sections.label: Problem
sections.text: Customers buying expensive electronics had few ways to spread the cost online.

sections.label: What I did
sections.text: Launched bank installments as a payment option at checkout, working with banking partners, payments and operations.

sections.label: Related
sections.text: With the Supply Chain team, introduced cash-on-delivery fees. This created a new revenue stream and reduced COD reliance by 1%.

cases.todo: Add: number of bank partners and how the launch was rolled out

cases.title: Automating MiniCash order processing
cases.result: Throughput capacity 50% → 95%; operational costs and lost sales down 20%.

sections.label: Problem
sections.text: MiniCash consumer-finance orders depended on manual processing. Capacity ran at half of demand, and slow orders became lost sales.

sections.label: What I did
sections.text: Led the implementation of end-to-end order processing automation, working with operations and engineering to remove manual steps.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Nearly double the throughput with a 20% cut in operational costs and lost sales.

cases.todo: Add: which manual steps were removed and how you measured capacity

principles.title: Metrics first
principles.text: Every squad goal starts with a success metric tied to a business objective, set quarterly and reviewed with BI.

principles.title: Both sides of the market
principles.text: I've led squads for end consumers and for marketplace sellers, so I design for how each side's experience affects the other.

principles.title: Ship with the whole team
principles.text: Design, UX research, data and engineering work as one squad, and cross-team bets like Brand Shops are delivered with partner teams.

experienceIntro: 8+ years across commerce, logistics and mobility products.

jobs.text: Leads the marketplace seller-experience squad (acquisition through performance management). Previously led the consumer shopping-experience squad of 6 engineers. Shipped installments, Brand Shops with the Ads team, COD fees, and 3PL integration improvements.
Led MiniCash order processing automation: throughput from 50% to 95% and a 20% cut in operational costs and lost sales.
Owned the rider app end to end for hundreds of active riders, improving onboarding and real-time order tracking.
Shipped a web and mobile ticket-booking system with real-time tracking for thousands of users, and a back-office platform for schedules, routes and customer operations.
